description: Pre-ADR negative guard: no generic canonical type token may activate a regulatory canonical type before ADR-DATACOMPANY-REGULATORY-MODEL is accepted. The instance carries a regulatory-family stem rather than one of the ten pinned denylist token spellings: this file is scanned by scripts/lint_contracts.py like every other JSON document in the repository, and spelling a pinned token here would be an activation the denylist must reject. Rejection of each pinned spelling is asserted directly in tests/test_canonical_schemas.py, which is Python and therefore not a contract document.
